game_concept: A arcade set in Sand Dunes – Sandstorm Pass, a pass in a sandstorm: the caravan guide must handle scarab swarms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Syntax Sweep: Spot and fix syntax errors such as missing colons or brackets before the program runs.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sandstorm Pass: a pass in a sandstorm
core_gameplay_loop: In Sandstorm Pass, repeat each round: Spot and fix syntax errors such as missing colons or brackets before the program runs. Each round, a new water flasks challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the syntax_errors value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 150 points of water flasks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 150, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 4 (applied tier): Syntax Sweep
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Syntax Sweep' (Week 9 slot 1), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Sandstorm Pass'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how syntax_errors changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against scarab swarms in Sandstorm Pass.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 150 within 55 seconds.
